title: Incremental vendor snapshots and kubelet preload hooks for airgap installer
author: Sofia Patel
description: Motivation: on large on-prem installs the full airgap bundle push and mirror updates take too long and make upgrades brittle. This PR introduces an incremental vendor snapshot format and associated registry delta application logic so mirror appliances can fetch/apply only changed asset groups, plus a kubelet-preload hook that pre-warms kernel modules and large runtime libraries on hosts that lack fast network access. Design summary: (1) snapshot format v1.1: top-level manifest points to named asset groups (images, charts, artifacts) with per-group content hashes and an optional parent-snapshot reference enabling incremental diffs; (2) registry-sync delta applier: server-side component that computes minimal push set and a client-side apply step that validates checksums and performs atomic swap; (3) GC-aware index: keep last N snapshots with a thin-refcounted index to avoid re-pushing unchanged blobs; (4) kubelet-preload hook: a small init container and a systemd-friendly unit that pulls and extracts preflight artifacts (kernel modules, containerd prefetch layers, nvidia drivers) into a host staging path before kubelet starts to avoid expensive runtime pulls. This PR contains installer UX (airgap index generation CLI), registry indexer, helm chart changes to expose preloadDaemonSet and a loader Job, terraform module additions for mirror lifecycle, and documentation/upgrade notes. Testing: local integration harness simulated slow links (100ms RTT, 10Mbps) and applied 10 incremental snapshots with a synthetic 8% asset churn to validate delta sizes and resume behavior; CI includes airgap-e2e matrix with k3s and rke2. Migration and upgrade notes: new snapshot format is backwards-compatible; the indexer emits a parent reference and a compatibility flag; older mirror-appliances ignore parent and perform full apply. Operators performing upgrades should run `rwi airgap inspect --dry-run` to preview delta size before applying. Rollback: snapshots are applied atomically using swap-and-validate; the apply step creates a timestamped symlink and performs a post-apply health check; on failure the previous symlink is retained and the apply aborts. Security: manifests are signed with cosign; registry-sync validates signatures and rejects unsigned snapshots when the "require_signed_snapshots" flag is true. Checklist: [x] Snapshot format and generator CLI implemented, [x] Server-side delta computation implemented, [x] Client apply + atomic swap implemented, [x] Kubelet preload hook unit and Helm values added, [x] Terraform module for mirror lifecycle added, [x] Integration tests with slow-link simulation included, [x] Docs and upgrade notes updated. Related: ENG-2179, INF-903, SUP-489. Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2179/airgap-incremental-snapshots; cosign verification reference https://github.com/sigstore/cosign. Manual steps and troubleshooting are in docs/airgap/incremental-snapshots.md

review_comments: Daniel Cho (2024-11-08): This is a strong iteration. Two questions: 1) how does the GC avoid accidentally dropping blobs referenced by older snapshots used by existing clusters? 2) can we expose a dry-run that reports OCI blob diff sizes without downloading?

Sofia Patel (2024-11-08): Answered: GC uses refcounts computed from the indexer across the last N snapshots configurable via mirror.retention_count; the dry-run mode for registry-sync computes and reports blob deltas using remote manifest queries only, no downloads.
Priya Nair (2024-11-10): Please add an option to require cosign signing for applies in the helm chart values and document the operator workflow when signature checks fail.
Sofia Patel (2024-11-10): Added require_signed_snapshots value with default=false and documented failure modes and remediation steps in docs.

Ethan McBride (2024-11-12): CI reported intermittent failure in kubelet-preload e2e when host disk is slow (ext4 with heavy journal). Suggest adding configurable timeouts and a preflight disk-check to the Job.
Sofia Patel (2024-11-12): Implemented disk-check and made timeouts configurable via values.preload.timeouts. Re-ran e2e matrix and green.

Marta Ruiz (2024-11-13): Security scan flags cosign-wrapper as shipping an unpinned cosign version; please pin the cosign release in packaging and add a CI step to validate checksum. Also request a short security blurb in release notes.
Sofia Patel (2024-11-13): Pinned cosign to v1.12.0 and added CI checksum check. Added security note to release notes.

notes_for_ops: Preview delta size: rwi airgap inspect --snapshot new.snap.tar.gz --dry-run
Enable signature enforcement: set values.require_signed_snapshots=true in charts/airgap/values.yaml
Rollbacks are atomic: the apply step creates a symlink swap; inspect /var/lib/redwood/mirror/current for active snapshot
Retention: default mirror.retention_count is 3, increase for longer rollbacks
